answers.question: Putting a gent vigilon on walk test
answers.text:
For EN Vigilon 4/6-loop / Compact panels using the MCC/MCB V4.53-or-higher menu map in 4188-856, issue 7 (07/15). This is Zone Test, not the separate BS Commission mode.

Use authorised engineer (Level 3) access. Before testing, obtain customer consent, inform affected people and the alarm receiving centre where connected, and arrange isolation of interfaced plant under the site procedure.

1. Press Menu On/Off → Test/Eng → UserCode and enter your authorised engineering password.
2. Use <etc> → Test → Test, then On. There are two Test selections in this EN menu map; do not use the separate Commission branch.
3. At the Zone entry, enter the zone number to test and select Enter. Check that the Test LED is lit.
4. Test the devices in that zone with the appropriate test equipment. With the default reset/silence behaviour, a fire event sounds the alarms for 5 seconds, then silences and resets automatically.
5. When finished, return through the same Test → Test route and select Off. At the Zone entry, enter the tested zone and select Enter. Check that the Test LED goes out; a completed test cycle or leaving the menu does not switch test mode off.

Zone Test inhibits delay-block, network, auxiliary and clean-contact relay functions described by the manual. Zones not in test continue normal operation.

Source note: the route follows the EN menu diagram on page 105. The shorter prose on page 81 differs in its Test/Zone ordering. If the displayed options do not match this map, confirm the panel version before proceeding.
